sealed.note: Sealed after the open. GitHub fired the after-close radar three hours late, at 00:28 UTC; the plan it saw held no entries and was sealed at 00:29 as this session's pre-open document. The 12:51 UTC re-plan from the finished bars found this entry, but the record was write-once per session and refused to seal it. The order went in at 13:43 UTC. This document was written afterwards, with its true time, so the trade is on the record rather than missing from it; the rule that refused the re-seal is gone.
